_comment: Turn-event tracking: read ATTACKED_TWICE_WITH_WEAPONS — private flag(s) nothing set. Attacks and token creation are now recorded by the engine and read via EVENT_THIS_TURN. Removed a plain STATIC holding PAY_OR_DAMAGE 1 -- the card has no pay-or-damage clause at all. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'Your second sword attack each turn costs {r} less', which needs the same board/ordinal-driven play-cost reduction the Evo tier cards are tracked for. SIMPLIFIED: the Copper clause is 'at the beginning of your end phase, IF you have attacked 2 or more times with weapons this turn, create a Copper FOR EACH weapon attack that HIT' -- it creates exactly one, unconditionally, because no turn event records weapon attacks or which of them hit.
